comment: The circuit is Don Cross's model of the hardware, solved by iteration each sample (SlothCircuit.hpp:124-196). The knob is the variable part of one resistance, 100k in series with 0 to 10k (SlothCircuit.hpp:100). The orbit times are the maker's README rather than anything in the code; the code differs between the three modules only in a time dilation factor and a starting capacitor voltage (SlothCircuit.hpp:200-224). No voltage range is stated anywhere for the two outputs, so none is given here.
